report_topic: Performance Audit on the functioning of Government High and Higher Secondary Schools
observations_summary: The audit found that despite Tamil Nadu ranking first nationally in providing school facilities, government high and higher secondary schools faced significant issues including declining student enrollment (14.76% and 11.84% respectively from 2016-21), a shortage of 31,490 teachers, and a deficit of 11,711 classrooms. These deficiencies, coupled with poor infrastructure maintenance and non-adherence to school upgrade norms, led to safety concerns and hindered the quality of education.
